title: Kiosk icon · Vintage Bucky on black
lede: Original vintage Bucky and Block W artwork, with a black background and more room around the mark.

sections.heading: Composer source verified
sections.note: After-only compiled preview: kiosk-ipad-preview.png. The previous icon was a flat catalog PNG; no matched Composer baseline exists. Default, Dark, and Mono appearances were inspected in Icon Composer.

changes.was: Logo occupied roughly 86% of the icon width.
changes.now: Vector width is approximately 78% of the 1024-point canvas (390 × 2.05). Background stays black.
